name: Psychic Phenomena (Deathwatch)
description: Rolled when a psyker uses a power Unfettered and rolls a double on the Focus Power Test, or whenever he Pushes a power. Add +10 for each additional power he is sustaining. Deathwatch, Table 6-1 (p. 187).

results.name: Dark Foreboding
results.text: A faint breeze blows past the psyker and those near him, and everyone gets the feeling that doom is about to befall them.

results.name: Warp Echo
results.text: For a few seconds, all noises cause sinister echoes, regardless of the surroundings.

results.name: Unholy Stench
results.text: The air around the psyker becomes permeated with a bizarre and foul smell.

results.name: Mind Warp
results.text: The psyker suffers 1 Insanity Point as his own inherent phobias, suspicions, and hatred surge to the surface of his mind in a wave of negative emotion.

results.name: Hoarfrost
results.text: The temperature plummets for an instant and a thin coating of frost covers everything within [[3d10]] metres of the psyker.

results.name: Aura of Taint
results.text: All animals within [[1d100]] metres of the psyker become spooked and agitated. Characters with Psyniscience can pinpoint the psyker as the cause.

results.name: Memory Worm
results.text: All people within line of sight of the psyker forget something trivial.

results.name: Spoilage
results.text: Food and drink go bad within [[5d10]] metres of the psyker.

results.name: Haunting Breeze
results.text: Winds whip up around the psyker for a few seconds, blowing light objects about and guttering fires within [[3d10]] metres of him.

results.name: Veil of Darkness
results.text: For a brief moment (effectively the remainder of the Round), an area within [[3d10]] metres of the psyker is plunged into immediate darkness.

results.name: Distorted Reflections
results.text: Mirrors and other reflective surfaces within [[5d10]] metres of the psyker distort or shatter.

results.name: Breath Leech
results.text: Everyone (including the psyker) becomes short of breath for 1 Round and cannot make any Run or Charge actions.

results.name: Daemonic Mask
results.text: For a fleeting moment the psyker takes on a Daemonic appearance and gains a Fear rating of 1 for the rest of the Round. He also gains 1 Corruption Point.

results.name: Unnatural Decay
results.text: All plant life within [[3d10]] metres of the psyker withers and dies.

results.name: Spectral Gale
results.text: Howling winds erupt around the psyker. The psyker and anyone within [[4d10]] metres of him must make an Easy (+30) Agility or Strength Test to avoid being knocked to the ground.

results.name: Bloody Tears
results.text: Blood weeps from stone and wood within [[3d10]] metres of the psyker. If there are any pictures or statues of people within this area, they appear to be crying blood.

results.name: The Earth Protests
results.text: The ground suddenly shakes and everyone (including the psyker) within [[5d10]] metres of the psyker must make a Routine (+10) Agility Test or be knocked down.

results.name: Psy Discharge
results.text: Static Electricity fills the air within [[5d10]] metres of the psyker, causing hair to stand on end and unprotected electrics to short out. The psyker is illuminated by eldritch light.

results.name: Warp Ghosts
results.text: Ghostly apparitions fill the air within [[3d10]] metres of the psyker, flying around and howling in pain for a few brief moments. Everyone within this area must test against Fear (1).

results.name: Falling Upwards
results.text: Everything within [[2d10]] metres of the psyker (including the psyker himself) rises [[1d10]] metres into the air as gravity briefly ceases. After a second or two, everything crashes back to earth. (See page 261 for rules on Falling Damage).

results.name: Banshee Howl
results.text: A shrill keening rings out across the immediate area, shattering glass and forcing every mortal creature able to hear it (including the psyker) to make a Challenging (+0) Toughness Test or be deafened for [[1d10]] rounds.

results.name: The Furies
results.text: The psyker is assailed by unseen horrors. He is slammed to the ground and suffers [[1d5]] Wounds in damage (Toughness protects, but armour, unless warded does not). The psyker must test against Fear (2).

results.name: Shadow of the Warp
results.text: For a split second the world changes in appearance and everyone within [[1d100]] metres of the psyker has a mercifully brief glimpse of the shadow of the Warp. Everyone in the area (including the psyker) must make a Difficult (–10) Willpower Test or gain [[1d5]] Insanity points.

results.name: Tech Scorn
results.text: The machine spirits reject the psyker’s unnatural ways. All unwarded tech devices within [[5d10]] metres of the psyker malfunction momentarily, and all ranged weapons within this area Jam (see page 249). Characters with cybernetic implants must pass a Routine (+10) Toughness Test or suffer [[1d5]] damage.

results.name: Warp Madness
results.text: A violent ripple of tainted discord causes all creatures within [[2d10]] metres of the psyker (with the exception of the psyker himself) to become Frenzied for 1 Round. Affected creatures gain [[1d5]] Corruption Points unless they can pass a Difficult (–10) Willpower Test.

results.name: Perils of the Warp
results.text: The Warp opens in a maelstrom of energy. Immediately make a roll on Table 6–2: Perils of the Warp.
